title:
Buy from Alibaba.
We handle the import.
intro: Found something on Alibaba? Send us the link. Not sure where to find it? Describe it or upload a photo. We send you a quote in Ghana cedis, and once you accept, we source it and bring it to you.

features.title: A link, a description or a photo
features.text: Paste an Alibaba link if you have one. If not, tell us in your own words what you want, or upload a photo, and we look for it.

features.title: A clear quote in cedis
features.text: We check the price and send your total in Ghana cedis. Shipping is quoted separately, and nothing is bought until you accept.

features.title: Delivered to you
features.text: We handle the sourcing, shipping and delivery to your address in Ghana, in about {days} days.

ctaText: Send us a link, a description or a photo. It takes about two minutes, and no payment is taken.
